subtitle: Lesson 18 · Visualizing Quantum States in Qiskit

eyebrow: Two new plots, one shared purpose
code:
from qiskit.visualization import plot_state_qsphere, plot_state_city

state = Statevector(qc)
plot_state_qsphere(state)
plot_state_city(state)
caption: Q-sphere: blob size = probability, blob color = relative phase. State-city: 3D bars for real and imaginary amplitude.
